bringup_flags.reason: Particle render 0x004bac60: the fog byte and the age fade go through retail's inline fistp helper. Only the low byte of each result is kept and fog is clamped to 0..1, so the 64-bit FISTP store cannot change a kept bit. No other float-to-int conversion in the unit. The EBP frame retail's inline asm gives Render3D comes from a #pragma optimize("y", off) region in the source.

Terrain::PrepareGeometry 0x00507610: the focal length (pixels) goes through retail's inline fistp helper. It is the unit's only float-to-int conversion. The EBP frame retail's inline asm gives it comes from a #pragma optimize("y", off) region in the source.

LightVertices 0x0049e4a0 and its three workers round light terms with retail's inline fistp helper. The truncating light-colour casts live in Group4_GridLightColor.cpp, compiled without the flag; the terms are colour bytes times facing values and stay in int range. The facing values are stored as binary32 first, as retail spills them around its asm blocks; differential emulation against retail found no colour difference in 6000 runs at 53- and 24-bit precision. The EBP frame retail's inline asm gives each of the four comes from a #pragma optimize("y", off) region in the source.
